newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak finmin says Q1 97' trade deficit SKK15.9bln.
newsitem.headline: Slovak finmin says Q1 97' trade deficit SKK15.9bln.

text.p: Slovak Finance Minister Sergej Kozlik said on Wednesday that according to preliminary data the country's foreign trade deficit was 15.9 billion crowns in the first quarter of this year, compared with 15.7 billion in the first quarter of 1996.
"We consider trade balance development, with a deficit of 15.9 billion crowns from January to March as fully in line with our plans," Kozlik told a news conference.
Slovakia posted a 10.82 billion crowns trade balance deficit in the first two months of this year and for the whole of 1996 the foreign trade deficit was 64.54 billion crowns.
